name: 圆柱立式智能光带冷暖柜机款
description: 圆柱立式柜机套图：雨夜光带视觉、快速冷暖、省地圆筒形态、触控屏与除湿全链路

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep night blue-grey studio #232B36 for hero and mood shots, cloud-mica light grey #F4F5F7 or white #FFFFFF for info and trust screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft directional studio key from the upper left with gentle rim light and soft contact shadows; the vertical display strip glowing cyan-blue #33B6FF as the set's signature accent light
styleLock.surfaceSystem: polished dark stone floor #1C232C with subtle reflections for mood shots, warm oak wood floor #C39A6B for footprint and home scenes
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif type, headline 28-48pt, charcoal text #2D2D2D on light screens and #FFFFFF on dark screens, labels 10-14pt, no serif or display faces
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons in cyan-blue #33B6FF on rounded white cards
styleLock.presentationRules: the tall cylindrical tower always upright with full height visible and a stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium tech climate-appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud-mica light grey #F4F5F7, deep night blue-grey #232B36, luminous cyan-blue accent #33B6FF and champagne-gold trim accent #B99B6B, with charcoal text #2D2D2D kept for typography on light screens; cool temperature; soft directional studio key light from the upper left with gentle rim light and soft contact shadows, the vertical display strip glowing cyan-blue as the signature accent; modern geometric sans-serif type for headline and label typesetting; consistent thin-line icons in cyan-blue #33B6FF on rounded white cards; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the tall cylindrical tower always upright with full height visible and a stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，白底合规展示圆柱柜机完整轮廓
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level with a slight front 3/4 angle, full-height tower centered and upright
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill, soft contact shadow under the round base
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The tall cylindrical tower standing upright and centered, photographed straight-on at eye level with a slight front 3/4 angle, full height visible including the round base, the tower filling 60-70% of the frame so the composition reads complete. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a soft front-left key and fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the base. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no gradient background, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 从 11 屏爆款立式圆柱空调柜机详情长图提炼；已剥离英文标语、能效标识图与二维码、会员店招、App 平台名、V 屏型号叫法及全部原文数值（能效比/功率/制冷量/占地/年份），数值类信息一律改写为 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 文案槽位由使用方填写真实内容，不发明任何认证与数据；产品一律以 {product} 占位。灰色占位屏与重复 WiFi 宫格仅保留结构思路。
